title: Private jet charter to the Maldives: permits and rules
description: Private flights to the Maldives: permission from the MCAA, the foreign operator permit for charters and the international airport at Malé, from official sources.
h1: Private flights to and from the Maldives
lead: Every private or charter flight to the Maldives needs the authority's permission first. What the rules are, how far ahead to plan, and what they mean for your trip.

p: The authority is the {{mv.authority}}. Its rule for non-scheduled flights: {{mv.permit}}.

For a charter flight the operator also has to be accepted: {{mv.notable}}. This takes time the first time an operator flies to the Maldives, so we check early whether the operator already holds the permission.

International arrivals use designated airports only: {{mv.customs_airports}}. The main gateway at Malé is operated by {{vrmm.operator}} and has a {{vrmm.runway}}. Resort transfers by seaplane or boat are arranged separately with the resort.

The operator that flies your trip applies, usually through its handling agent or a flight-permit service. You do not need to deal with the authority yourself. What you can do is give us final names, passport details and times early, because a permit is issued for a given aircraft, schedule and passenger list, and late changes can mean a new application.

sections.h: How we plan a private flight to or from the Maldives
p: Tell us where you are flying from or to, when, and how many people are travelling. We find aircraft from licensed operators, check each operator against our safety standard before you see a quote, and ask the operator to apply for the permits early, because the authority's answer decides the schedule. Any aircraft, any route, upon availability.
Permit rules change. The operator and its handling agent confirm the current rules for your flight before departure; every fact on this page shows its official source and the date we checked it.

faq.q: Can any private jet operator fly to the Maldives?
faq.a: A charter operator needs the authority's permission first: {{mv.notable}}. We check that the operator holds it before you see a quote.

faq.q: Does Archē Executive operate the flight?
faq.a: No. We are a broker. A licensed operator flies every trip, and it is named in your quote and charter agreement before you confirm.
